_meta.description: Pilot departments with their NUTS2 region, dominant soil archetype, arable area and current pulse share. Pulse share and arable area are order-of-magnitude planning figures for the macro heatmap, not official SAA values.

28.name: Eure-et-Loir
28.notes: Beauce. High-potential deep loam, intensive wheat-barley-rapeseed rotations, low current pulse share.

21.name: Cote-d'Or
21.notes: Plateaux calcaires. Shallow stony soils, strong existing lentil and mustard tradition, summer drought limited.

32.name: Gers
32.notes: Coteaux de Gascogne. Clay-loam hillsides, durum wheat and sunflower base, strong fit for chickpea and soy under irrigation.

51.name: Marne
51.notes: Champagne cretacee. Established protein pea area.

86.name: Vienne
86.notes: Groies. Drought-prone shallow soils favouring chickpea and lentil over pea.
